name: matrix
body:
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Range("A1:F6").UnMerge
Range("A1:F6").Clear
Range("A1:B6").Value = 7
Range("C3:D4").Value = "old"
Dim a(1 To 2, 1 To 2) As Variant
a(1, 1) = "=RC[-1]"
a(1, 2) = "=R1C1"
a(2, 1) = 12
a(2, 2) = "text"
On Error Resume Next
Range("C3:D4").FormulaR1C1 = a
n = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Report = CStr(n)
For Each cell In Range("C3:D4")
Report = Report & "|" & CStr(cell.FormulaR1C1) & ":" & TypeName(cell.Value) & ":" & CStr(cell.Value)
Next cell
